image_generation.prompt: Edit target: the supplied single-character beagle concept. Change ONLY the two ears. Preserve the existing face, head proportions, white blaze, sleepy half-lidded eyes, muzzle, nose, smirk, tiny white torso, tucked paws, feet, tail and terracotta bib exactly as they are. Make BOTH ears about 1.7 times wider than the current ears, with fuller pillow-like volume and a softer plush appearance. Retain their basic hanging length for this reference, their anatomical head roots, their gentle outward bow and rounded ends. Keep a small clean gap between each ear and torso. The broad ears should have subtly lobed, softly scalloped outer contours, with three very shallow rounded tufts per outer edge, and a rounded padded tip; cohesive large shapes rather than long hairs. Surface is soft matte short plush with delicate velvety microtexture. The game character should remain clean, readable and cute at small sizes. No individual fur strands, no fluffy halo, no spikes, no photoreal animal hair, no pink inner ears, no mechanical parts, no extra joints, no accessories. Keep the forehead and face as in the target. The ears must visibly feel wider, fuller and softer, not simply flat triangles. One complete character alone, near-orthographic front view, evenly lit neutral studio illustration with convincing smooth 3D volume. Increase the transparent canvas width as needed to fit the broader ears with generous margins; never crop the ears. No text, no watermark, no scenery, no pedestal. Transparent background.
